newsitem.title: USA: SunTrust reports record quarterly earnings.
newsitem.headline: SunTrust reports record quarterly earnings.

text.p: SunTrust Banks Inc Tuesday reported record quarterly earnings, narrowly beating analysts' estimates.
"The earnings are essentially in line with expectations, one cent up," said Sandra Flannigan of Merrill Lynch in New York. "Delivery as expected is a hallmark of Suntrust."
The bank posted a net income of $0.77 a share, while an April 8 First Call consensus of 21 brokers put SunTrust earnings at $0.76 a share.
SunTrust chief executive James Williams said in a statement "the record earnings reflect strong revenue growth and improved expense control."
The bank posted $479.2 million in net interest income in the second quarter, compared with $454.2 million the year before.
SunTrust's expenses actuallly rose 5.1 percent to $413.3 million for the quarter, primarily because of personel costs. increasing to $235.3 million,up 9.6 percent from $214.7 a year ago.
Net income rose to $165.4 million, or $0.77 as share, for the quarter, compared with $152.1 million, or $0.68 a share, the year before.
The bank had $55.5 billion in assets as of June 30, compared with $48.1 billion a year ago. Loans increased 16.3 percent to $37.7 billion and deposits 2.3 percent to 35.8 billion.

The bank upped its reserve for loan losses to $740 million from $723 million the year before. Its non-performing assets decreased $20.9 million to $213.9 million from March 31, their lowest level since 1988, SunTrust said.
A bank official was not immediately available for comment. SunTrust's stock traded at 58-3/16 Tuesday morning, up 13/16 and close to the 52-week high of 59 it hit on June 19.
